normal_close_evidence.method: Direct X11 ClientMessage: message_type WM_PROTOCOLS, format 32, data[0]=WM_DELETE_WINDOW, data[1]=CurrentTime; no window manager required
normal_close_evidence.historical_automation_error: Earlier xdotool windowclose used XDestroyWindow and caused GDK BadWindow exit 133. The standard WM_DELETE_WINDOW retest exits 0; the earlier destructive automation is not evidence of a normal application close failure.
